name: Blackrock Depths

entrance.note: South of Thorium Point into Blackrock Mountain, then the BRD portal. Alternate Burning Steppes mouth 29.4, 38.3. Coordinates from research/dungeons/dungeons.json (Questie dungeons.lua).

travel.how: From Kargath ride west into Searing Gorge, grab Thorium Point, then south into Blackrock Mountain. From Flame Crest ride west to the mountain. Run BRD once around 55 while the 40-60 route is already in Searing Gorge / Burning Steppes — do not hearth back from Un'Goro for this instance.

keys.name: Shadowforge Key
keys.from: Dark Iron Legacy (3801/3802), Franclorn Forgewright in Blackrock Mountain (Burning Steppes 29.0, 28.9 in questie-db)
keys.opens: Inner BRD gates (Shadowforge City, Lyceum, many shortcuts toward the Emperor)
keys.note: Optional on a prison / Ring of Law / Grim Guzzler leveling run. Take it if the group is clearing to Incendius or the Emperor.

keys.name: Prison Cell Key
keys.from: Drops from High Interrogator Gerstahn in the Detention Block
keys.note: Required to finish 3981/3982 on the Kargath prison path.

keys.name: Relic Coffer Key
keys.from: Drops from Shadowforge dwarves inside BRD
keys.opens: Relic coffers in the vault; needed for 4123 The Heart of the Mountain (Dark Coffer)
keys.note: Farm during the same clear as Heart of the Mountain.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 52-60; do not enter before 55 (runAt). BRD is a long instance — one planned clear (prison + arena + Grim Guzzler, add Incendius/Argelmach if the group is fast), not a farm reset.
warnings: One run around 55 while the route is in Searing Gorge / Burning Steppes. Do not travel back from Un'Goro.
Pick up Kargath posters and Thunderheart / Galamav / Vivian / Theodora quests, plus Flame Crest Maxwort and Yuka, before you enter.
Kill Pyron (3906) in the BRM quarry on the way in.
Decide the slice before you zone: prison (Gor'shak), Ring of Law, Grim Guzzler (Ribbly, Thunderbrew), vault (Heart), Incendius, Argelmach. Emperor / Princess is a later trip.
Skip Onyxia/Nefarian/MC attunement, Dreadsteed, Dungeon Set 2, and the Thrall Princess chain on this run.
Avoid patrolling golems; drink during the Ring of Law reset.
classQuests: Warlock Dreadsteed lead-ins 7562-7564 and 7627 Wheel of the Black March (endgame; skip while leveling).

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Thorium Point kill quests in horde-40-60.route.json (Fat Fingers, Fiery Menace, Incendosaurs, What the Flux) are the slow same-band outdoor XP a mid-50s BRD clear replaces.
Flame Crest outdoor loops in horde-40-60.route.json sit next to the BRM entrance; BRD quest XP beats Broodling Essence and Tablet of the Seven.

notes: Horde-only leveling dossier. Pickup hubs are Kargath, Flame Crest, and Thorium Point at 50-56. BRD is huge: one mid-50s run while the route is in Searing Gorge / Burning Steppes, not a trip back from Un'Goro. Dungeons-off replacement: Burning Steppes, Western Plaguelands, Eastern Plaguelands and Winterspring. XP figures are Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db.
